title: Fifty Shades of Grey
author: E. L. James
summary: A recent college graduate interviews a young, rich businessman and is drawn into an intense relationship in which he insists on a contract and control over how it works, while she tries to reach the man behind it.
readIf: you want a very explicit, fast-reading contemporary romance that became a cultural phenomenon.
skipIf: you dislike controlling partners or repetitive prose, or want sex scenes toned down.

pairings.reason: A fantasy romance with similarly steamy scenes and a brooding, powerful love interest.
Another heated, emotionally intense romance with a guarded hero.
A much lighter, funnier romance with plenty of tension and less control.
